description.value: Argo Greek is a family-owned and operated Greek counter-service restaurant specializing in authentic Greek cuisine alongside pizzas and fresh pastas, named after the mythological ship of Jason and the Argonauts. It operates as a takeout and delivery-focused establishment with a robust catering program serving groups up to 150 guests. The business prides itself on Mediterranean dietary traditions and accommodates vegan, vegetarian, and dairy-free diners.
